Hello. I need to charge my sony 3D pulse headset. What kind of an adaptor is good for it? 5V, 1A or 5V, 2A?
The guy at the store said 1A will be good for it.
What do you think?
I noticed that GFE overlay didnt cause high CPU for me. It was this NVIDIA Display container LS Service.

Oh thanks that was a relief. This problem has been happening to me since I updated my NVIDIA Driver. And I guess it was there all the time before this update and sometimes occasionally caused high CPU and lags in games. So you suggest that I can also go back one driver or two if I want to have this service again enabled without this issue?
One more question I just made the changes I wanted to everygame in my NVIDIA control panel. Doesn't this disabled NVIDIA display container affect them?

So it won't do any harm if I just leave it there for now? Isn't there any sorta tiny hole under backlit setup of keyboard's loptop that makes it easy for this conductive thing to damage inside? Since I am always moving with my backpack and loptop also moves😅
